value.name: brief.md
value.content:
# Atlas Launch brief

Goal: ship the Atlas planner beta to 200 pilot teams by 2026-10-15.

## Audience
Operations leads at small logistics firms.

## Success metrics
- 60% weekly retention after four weeks
- Median onboarding under 15 minutes
- Fewer than 5 support tickets per 100 teams

## Risks
- Onboarding takes longer than 20 minutes
- Calendar sync delays

## Owners
Maya Chen (launch), Priya Natarajan (design), Tomas Weller (support)
